The triangle inequality is a fundamental result in mathematics that formalizes
the intuitive notion that the shortest path between two points in a space is
the "straight" line between them. It has multiple definitions based on the
space considered and the concept of distance used including [[normed-space]],
[[euclidean-space]],
[[knowledge-mathematics-analysis-functional-analysis-metric-spaces]] and
[[measure-space]].

:::{.theorem data-title="Triangle Inequality - Normed Space"}

In a normed vector space $V$ one of the defining properties of the norm us the triangle inequality $$\|u+v\|\leq\|u\|+\|v\|$$for all $u,v\in V$.

:::
